area-picker

Selectable SVG maps generated from any GeoJSON file: neighbourhoods, provinces, countries. One script builds the SVG, one shared CSS file styles every map, and external checkboxes stay in sync with no extra code. Read the docs.

Inline SVG + checkboxes

Click the map or the checkboxes; each one follows the other. Keyboard works too: Tab to an area, Enter or Space to toggle it.

{{caba-barrios.svg}}
Selectednone
{{caba-barrios.inputs}}
How this is wired 
<link rel="stylesheet" href="area-picker.css">

<!-- the generated SVG, pasted inline (without its <?xml ...?> lines) -->
<svg class="area-picker" data-ap-map="caba-barrios" ...>...</svg>

<!-- any checkbox with data-area-picker = the map id and value = an area id -->
<label><input type="checkbox" data-area-picker="caba-barrios" value="palermo"> Palermo</label>

<object> embed, single selection

Countries of South America, built with --single and loaded as a separate file through <object>. Including area-picker.js in the page keeps the radio buttons in sync through postMessage.

Selectednone
{{sudamerica-paises.inputs}}
How this is wired 
<object type="image/svg+xml" data="sudamerica-paises.svg"></object>

<label><input type="radio" name="country" data-area-picker="sudamerica-paises" value="peru"> Perú</label>

<script src="area-picker.js"></script>

Listening to changes

Every inline map fires an areachange event and exposes a small API. The "Selected" lines on this page use exactly this:

const map = document.querySelector('svg[data-ap-map="caba-barrios"]');

map.addEventListener('areachange', (e) => {
  console.log(e.detail.name, e.detail.selected, e.detail.selection);
});

map.areaPicker.select('palermo');   // also: toggle(id), clear(), selected(), areas()

Data: Buenos Aires Data (GCBA), Georef AR / IGN, Natural Earth. Original 2013 canvas version: old/.
